 **Status:** Proposed
-**Implemented:** partial — **BEAM** self-hosting (§4): Stage 0/1 equivalence-locked (ported lexer + the **full `Rian.Pratt` grammar**, no projection; `Rian.Fixpoint`, `examples/rian/selfhost_*.rian`; `test/rian/fixpoint_test.exs`, `parse_fixpoint_test.exs`), the surface→Core lowering **fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_core.rian` equals `Rian.Core.from_expr`/`from_pat` over the whole surface-reachable expression+pattern vocabulary; `core_fixpoint_test.exs`), the capability checker ported over the scalar/String/Vec/nominal slice (`selfhost_cap.rian` equals `Rian.Capability`; `cap_fixpoint_test.exs`), the exhaustiveness gate ported over the single-column nullary-constructor slice (`selfhost_exhaust.rian` agrees with Maranget `useful?/3`; `exhaust_fixpoint_test.exs`), the ECMAScript backend's expression emitter ported over the literal/unary/binary slice (`selfhost_js.rian` equals `Rian.JS` term-for-term; `js_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **Kotlin/JVM backend fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_jvm.rian` — whole-module emission incl. sum hierarchies + multi-clause pattern dispatch — equals `Rian.JVM.compile`; `jvm_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), the Rust/BEAM backends' expression emitters ported over a slice (`selfhost_rust.rian` = `Rian.Lower.emit_expr`; `selfhost_beam.rian` = `:erl_parse`'s abstract forms; `rust_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`/`beam_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`), a slice of the real type checker ported (`selfhost_checker.rian` agrees with `Rian.Check.infer` on closed integer expressions; `checker_infer_fixpoint_test.exs`); the **capability checker** and the **exhaustiveness gate** are now fully self-hosted (`selfhost_cap.rian` reproduces the whole `Rian.Capability` rust-param matrix; `selfhost_exhaust.rian` reproduces the complete Maranget `Rian.Exhaustiveness.useful?`), Stage 2 near-complete (decl front-end IR-equals `Rian.Decl`), Stage 3 (`v1==v2` `.beam`) not. The marching boundary is **measured** (`Rian.SelfHost` → `docs/self-host-status.md`, `test/rian/self_host_status_test.exs`), FFI crutches are **counted+enforced** (`@selfhost_ffi` ledger, `self_host_ffi_test.exs`), and the two untested-fragility areas now have fixpoints with teeth (`checker_fixpoint_test.exs`, `string_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`). **Portable** self-hosting (compile-the-compiler to Rust/JS) is a *separate, further* terminus, gated on ADR-0047 breadth + the `Fn` Reach gap — not near.

The marching boundary is **measured** (`Rian.SelfHost` → `docs/self-host-status.md`, `test/rian/self_host_status_test.exs`), FFI crutches are **counted+enforced** (`@selfhost_ffi` ledger, `self_host_ffi_test.exs`), and the two untested-fragility areas now have fixpoints with teeth (`checker_fixpoint_test.exs`, `string_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`). **Portable** self-hosting (compile-the-compiler to Rust/JS) is a *separate, further* terminus, gated on ADR-0047 breadth + the `Fn` Reach gap — not near.
 **Refs:** ADR-0027 (fast track to self-hosting), ADR-0031 (reuse the runtime, not the compiler; abstract-forms backend), ADR-0050 (typed core IR — one IR, many front/back ends), ADR-0047 (portable prelude — the stdlib the ported compiler leans on), SELFHOST.md (the blocker ledger + the lexer/parser fixpoints)
 **Owners:** Arthur Pendelton (compilers) · Chloe Bennett (parser) · Maya Lin (architecture) · Samir Patel (conformance) · Kira Neri (honesty) · Rachel Okafor (PM)

@@ -1,66 +1,331 @@
 # ===========================================================================
-# SELF-HOSTING SPIKE — the ECMAScript backend, written in Rian
+# SELF-HOSTING — the ECMAScript backend (whole module), written in Rian
 # ===========================================================================
-# Goal (ADR-0063 §2 backend rung; ADR-0049 Tier 1): emit JS source text from the
-# typed Core IR. This is the Rian-written counterpart of `Rian.JS`'s expression
-# emitter, fixpoint-locked against it in `test/rian/js_fixpoint_test.exs`: the
-# port's output for an expression equals the JS the reference emits (the `return`
-# expression of the compiled function), term-for-term.
+# Goal (ADR-0063 §2 backend rung; ADR-0049 Tier 1): emit a whole JS module from
+# the IR — the Rian-written counterpart of `Rian.JS`'s `compile/1` emission,
+# fixpoint-locked against it in `test/rian/js_module_fixpoint_test.exs`.
 #
-# Slice (the Core slice `selfhost_core.rian` produces): number/string/identifier/
-# atom literals, prefix unary (`-`/`not`), and binary operators. The operator
-# spellings are the point — `and`→`&&`, `or`→`||`, `==`→`===`, `!=`→`!==`,
-# `<>`→`+`, atoms→quoted strings — and binary is always parenthesised.
+# Coverage is the full expression + function surface: functions with multi-clause
+# pattern dispatch (each clause `{ [if (tests) {] binds; return … [}] }`, the
+# trailing throw), sum variants (tagged arrays `["Ctor", …]`), structs
+# (`{__struct__: "Name", …}`), tuples/lists (with `...`-spread tail)/maps, `.field`,
+# `if` (ternary), `case` (IIFE), operators, atoms (→ strings), and primitives.
 #
-# Remaining `Rian.JS` vocabulary (calls, lists, maps, `if`/`case`, structs,
-# prims, FFI) is the `:partial` tail — see ADR-0063 / docs/self-host-status.md.
+# The stage consumes Core (parsing is the parser/Core stage's job). The corpus is
+# in number-mode (`Int53`); protocol dispatchers, the whole-program int-mode
+# determination, and `Rian.Shadow` rename of shadowed binds are out of scope (a
+# program-level / separate-subsystem concern, like `@external` for the JVM port).
 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 mod SelfhostJs do
-  # The typed Core IR node (the slice `Rian.Core.from_expr` produces here).
   type Core := CNum(String)
+             | CChar(Int53)
              | CStr(String)
              | CId(String)
              | CAtom(String)
              | CUnary(String, Core)
              | CBin(String, Core, Core)
              | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
+             | CStruct(String, Vec(Pair))
+             | CTuple(Vec(Core))
+             | CList(Vec(Core), Tail)
+             | CMap(Vec(Pair))
+             | CDot(Core, String)
+             | CIf(Core, Block, Block)
+             | CCase(Core, Vec(Arm))
 
-  # Wrap a string literal in double quotes (the JS spelling of strings/atoms).
-  def dq(s String) String := "\"" <> s <> "\""
+  type Tail := TClose | TTail(Core)
+  type Pair := P(String, Core)
+  type Block := Block(Vec(Stmt))
+  type Stmt := SBind(String, Core) | STypedBind(String, String, Core) | SExpr(Core)
+
+  type Pat := PWild
+            | PVar(String)
+            | PLitInt(Int53)
+            | PLitStr(String)
+            | PChar(Int53)
+            | PAtom(String)
+            | PCtor(String, Vec(Pat))
+            | PTuple(Vec(Pat))
+            | PList(Vec(Pat), PTail)
+
+  type PTail := PtlClose | PtlTail(Pat)
+  type Guard := GNone | GSome(Core)
+  type Arm := Arm(Pat, Guard, Block)
+  type Clause := Clause(Vec(Pat), Guard, Block)
+  type Func := Func(String, Bool, Int53, Vec(Clause))
+
+  type Bind := B(String, String)
+  struct Match(tests Vec(String), binds Vec(Bind))
+
+  def app(Vec(T), Vec(T)) Vec(T)
+  def app([], ys) := ys
+  def app([x | xs], ys) := [x | app(xs, ys)]
+
+  def pascal(s String) Bool
+    case Prim.str_chars(s) do
+      [c | _] -> c >= 65 and c <= 90
+      [] -> false
+    end
+  end
+
+  def int_str(n Int53) String := Prim.int_to_string(n)
+
+  # ── module / functions ──
+  pub def compile_prog(Vec(Func)) String
+  pub def compile_prog([]) := ""
+  pub def compile_prog([f]) := function_js(f)
+  pub def compile_prog([f | rest]) := function_js(f) <> "\n\n" <> compile_prog(rest)
+
+  def function_js(Func) String
+  def function_js(Func(name, pb, arity, clauses)) :=
+    export(pb) <> "function " <> name <> "(" <> params(0, arity) <> ") {\n" <>
+      clauses_js(clauses) <> "  throw new Error(" <> js_str(name <> ": no clause matched") <> ");\n}"
+
+  def export(Bool) String
+  def export(pb)
+    if pb do
+      "export "
+    else
+      ""
+    end
+  end
+
+  def params(Int53, Int53) String
+  def params(i, n)
+    if i >= n do
+      ""
+    else
+      sep(i) <> "a" <> int_str(i) <> params(i + 1, n)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def sep(Int53) String
+  def sep(0) := ""
+  def sep(i) := ", "
+
+  def clauses_js(Vec(Clause)) String
+  def clauses_js([]) := ""
+  def clauses_js([c | rest]) := clause_js(c) <> "\n" <> clauses_js(rest)
+
+  def clause_js(Clause) String
+  def clause_js(Clause(pats, guard, body))
+    m := clause_match(pats)
+    inner := bind_lines(m.binds) <> guarded_return(body, guard)
+    "  { " <> wrap_tests(m.tests, inner) <> " }"
+  end
+
+  def wrap_tests(Vec(String), String) String
+  def wrap_tests([], inner) := inner
+  def wrap_tests(tests, inner) := "if (" <> join_and(tests) <> ") { " <> inner <> " }"
+
+  def join_and(Vec(String)) String
+  def join_and([]) := ""
+  def join_and([t]) := t
+  def join_and([t | rest]) := t <> " && " <> join_and(rest)
+
+  def bind_lines(Vec(Bind)) String
+  def bind_lines([]) := ""
+  def bind_lines([B(n, a) | rest]) := "const " <> n <> " = " <> a <> "; " <> bind_lines(rest)
+
+  def guarded_return(Block, Guard) String
+  def guarded_return(body, GNone) := clause_return(body)
+  def guarded_return(body, GSome(g)) := "if (" <> emit(g) <> ") { " <> clause_return(body) <> " }"
+
+  def clause_return(Block) String
+  def clause_return(Block(stmts)) := block_return(stmts)
+
+  def block_return(Vec(Stmt)) String
+  def block_return([SExpr(e)]) := "return " <> emit(e) <> ";"
+  def block_return(stmts) := lets_of(init_of(stmts)) <> " " <> stmt_return(last_of(stmts))
+
+  def init_of(Vec(Stmt)) Vec(Stmt)
+  def init_of([_]) := []
+  def init_of([x | rest]) := [x | init_of(rest)]
+
+  def last_of(Vec(Stmt)) Stmt
+  def last_of([x]) := x
+  def last_of([_ | rest]) := last_of(rest)
+
+  def lets_of(Vec(Stmt)) String
+  def lets_of([]) := ""
+  def lets_of([s]) := stmt_js(s)
+  def lets_of([s | rest]) := stmt_js(s) <> " " <> lets_of(rest)
+
+  def stmt_js(Stmt) String
+  def stmt_js(SBind(n, e)) := "let " <> n <> " = " <> emit(e) <> ";"
+  def stmt_js(STypedBind(n, _, e)) := "let " <> n <> " = " <> emit(e) <> ";"
+  def stmt_js(SExpr(e)) := emit(e) <> ";"
+
+  def stmt_return(Stmt) String
+  def stmt_return(SExpr(e)) := "return " <> emit(e) <> ";"
+  def stmt_return(SBind(_, e)) := "return " <> emit(e) <> ";"
+  def stmt_return(STypedBind(_, _, e)) := "return " <> emit(e) <> ";"
+
+  # ── clause/case pattern matching -> tests + binds ──
+  def clause_match(Vec(Pat)) Match
+  def clause_match(pats) := cm(pats, 0, [], [])
+
+  def cm(Vec(Pat), Int53, Vec(String), Vec(Bind)) Match
+  def cm([], _, ts, bs) := Match(tests: ts, binds: bs)
+  def cm([p | rest], i, ts, bs)
+    m := pat_match(p, "a" <> int_str(i))
+    cm(rest, i + 1, app(ts, m.tests), app(bs, m.binds))
+  end
+
+  def pat_match(Pat, String) Match
+  def pat_match(PWild, _) := Match(tests: [], binds: [])
+  def pat_match(PVar(n), acc) := Match(tests: [], binds: [B(n, acc)])
+  def pat_match(PLitInt(v), acc) := Match(tests: [acc <> " === " <> int_str(v)], binds: [])
+  def pat_match(PLitStr(v), acc) := Match(tests: [acc <> " === " <> js_str(v)], binds: [])
+  def pat_match(PChar(cp), acc) := Match(tests: [acc <> " === " <> int_str(cp)], binds: [])
+  def pat_match(PAtom(a), acc) := Match(tests: [acc <> " === " <> js_str(a)], binds: [])
+  def pat_match(PCtor(ctor, args), acc)
+    inner := pm_seq(args, acc, 1, [], [])
+    Match(tests: [acc <> "[0] === " <> js_str(ctor) | inner.tests], binds: inner.binds)
+  end
+  def pat_match(PTuple(es), acc)
+    inner := pm_idx(es, acc, 0, [], [])
+    Match(tests: [acc <> ".length === " <> int_str(len(es)) | inner.tests], binds: inner.binds)
+  end
+  def pat_match(PList(es, PtlClose), acc)
+    inner := pm_idx(es, acc, 0, [], [])
+    Match(tests: [acc <> ".length === " <> int_str(len(es)) | inner.tests], binds: inner.binds)
+  end
+  def pat_match(PList(es, PtlTail(t)), acc)
+    inner := pm_idx(es, acc, 0, [], [])
+    tm := pat_match(t, acc <> ".slice(" <> int_str(len(es)) <> ")")
+    plist_match(acc, len(es), inner, tm)
+  end
+
+  def plist_match(acc String, n Int53, inner Match, tm Match) Match :=
+    Match(tests: [acc <> ".length >= " <> int_str(n) | app(inner.tests, tm.tests)], binds: app(inner.binds, tm.binds))
+
+  # sequence sub-patterns at `acc[base], acc[base+1], …` (ctor fields: base 1).
+  def pm_seq(Vec(Pat), String, Int53, Vec(String), Vec(Bind)) Match
+  def pm_seq([], _, _, ts, bs) := Match(tests: ts, binds: bs)
+  def pm_seq([p | rest], acc, i, ts, bs)
+    m := pat_match(p, acc <> "[" <> int_str(i) <> "]")
+    pm_seq(rest, acc, i + 1, app(ts, m.tests), app(bs, m.binds))
+  end
+
+  # sequence sub-patterns at `acc[0], acc[1], …` (tuple/list elements).
+  def pm_idx(Vec(Pat), String, Int53, Vec(String), Vec(Bind)) Match
+  def pm_idx([], _, _, ts, bs) := Match(tests: ts, binds: bs)
+  def pm_idx([p | rest], acc, i, ts, bs)
+    m := pat_match(p, acc <> "[" <> int_str(i) <> "]")
+    pm_idx(rest, acc, i + 1, app(ts, m.tests), app(bs, m.binds))
+  end
+
+  # ── case arms ──
+  def arms_js(Vec(Arm)) String
+  def arms_js([]) := ""
+  def arms_js([a | rest]) := arm_js(a) <> " " <> arms_js(rest)
+
+  def arm_js(Arm) String
+  def arm_js(Arm(pat, guard, body))
+    m := pat_match(pat, "_s")
+    inner := bind_lines(m.binds) <> arm_return(body, guard)
+    wrap_tests(m.tests, inner)
+  end
+
+  def arm_return(Block, Guard) String
+  def arm_return(body, GNone) := "return " <> branch_js(body) <> ";"
+  def arm_return(body, GSome(g)) := "if (" <> emit(g) <> ") { return " <> branch_js(body) <> "; }"
+
+  # ── expression emission ──
+  def emit(Core) String
+  def emit(CNum(n)) := n
+  def emit(CChar(cp)) := int_str(cp)
+  def emit(CStr(s)) := js_str(s)
+  def emit(CId(x))
+    if pascal(x) do
+      "[" <> js_str(x) <> "]"
+    else
+      x
+    end
+  end
+  def emit(CAtom(a)) := js_str(a)
+  def emit(CUnary("-", x)) := "-" <> emit(x)
+  def emit(CUnary("not", x)) := "!" <> emit(x)
+  def emit(CBin("div", l, r)) := "Math.trunc(" <> emit(l) <> " / " <> emit(r) <> ")"
+  def emit(CBin(op, l, r)) := "(" <> emit(l) <> " " <> jsop(op) <> " " <> emit(r) <> ")"
+  def emit(CCall("__prim_int_to_string", [n])) := "String(" <> emit(n) <> ")"
+  def emit(CCall("__prim_int_to_float", [n])) := "Number(" <> emit(n) <> ")"
+  def emit(CCall("__prim_str_concat", [a, b])) := "(" <> emit(a) <> " + " <> emit(b) <> ")"
+  def emit(CCall(f, args))
+    if pascal(f) do
+      "[" <> js_str(f) <> comma_rest(args) <> "]"
+    else
+      f <> "(" <> emit_args(args) <> ")"
+    end
+  end
+  def emit(CStruct(name, pairs)) := "{ __struct__: " <> js_str(name) <> struct_fields(pairs) <> " }"
+  def emit(CTuple(es)) := "[" <> emit_args(es) <> "]"
+  def emit(CList(es, TClose)) := "[" <> emit_args(es) <> "]"
+  def emit(CList(es, TTail(t))) := "[" <> list_spread(es, t) <> "]"
+  def emit(CMap(pairs)) := "{" <> map_fields(pairs) <> "}"

+defmodule Rian.JsModuleFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — loads a real module into the VM via :code.load_binary.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.{Beam, Core, Decl, JS, Pratt}
+
+  # Self-hosting fixpoint (ADR-0063) for the **ECMAScript backend** (whole module):
+  # a Rian-written port of `Rian.JS`'s emission (examples/rian/selfhost_js.rian),
+  # compiled to real `.beam`, diffed against `Rian.JS.compile` over a corpus
+  # covering its expression + function surface — sum variants (tagged arrays),
+  # structs, tuples/lists/maps, `.field`, `if`, `case`, multi-clause dispatch.
+  #
+  # The backend stage consumes Core/IR, so this test does the front-end work and
+  # injects the lowered IR; the port emits the whole module, which must equal
+  # `Rian.JS`'s output exactly. The corpus is number-mode (`Int53`), shadow-free,
+  # and protocol-free (protocol dispatch / int-mode / Shadow are out of scope).
+
+  setup_all do
+    {:ok, mod} = Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_js.rian"), :rian_js_module_fixpoint)
+    {:ok, mod: mod}
+  end
+
+  # ── Core struct -> the port's Core sum ──
+  defp ic(%Core.ENum{text: t}), do: {:c_num, t}
+  defp ic(%Core.EChar{value: v}), do: {:c_char, v}
+  defp ic(%Core.EStr{value: v}), do: {:c_str, v}
+  defp ic(%Core.EId{name: n}), do: {:c_id, n}
+  defp ic(%Core.EAtom{name: a}), do: {:c_atom, a}
+  defp ic(%Core.EUnary{op: op, arg: a}), do: {:c_unary, op, ic(a)}
+  defp ic(%Core.EBin{op: op, left: l, right: r}), do: {:c_bin, op, ic(l), ic(r)}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.ECall{fun: %Core.EId{name: f}, args: [%Core.ELabel{} | _] = args}),
+    do: {:c_struct, f, Enum.map(args, fn %Core.ELabel{name: k, expr: e} -> {:p, k, ic(e)} end)}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.ECall{fun: %Core.EId{name: f}, args: args}),
+    do: {:c_call, f, Enum.map(args, &ic/1)}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.ETuple{elems: es}), do: {:c_tuple, Enum.map(es, &ic/1)}
+  defp ic(%Core.EList{elems: es, tail: :close}), do: {:c_list, Enum.map(es, &ic/1), :t_close}
+  defp ic(%Core.EList{elems: es, tail: t}), do: {:c_list, Enum.map(es, &ic/1), {:t_tail, ic(t)}}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.EMap{pairs: pairs}),
+    do: {:c_map, Enum.map(pairs, fn {k, v} -> {:p, k, ic(v)} end)}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.EStruct{name: name, pairs: pairs}),
+    do: {:c_struct, to_string(name), Enum.map(pairs, fn {k, v} -> {:p, k, ic(v)} end)}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.EDot{head: h, name: f}), do: {:c_dot, ic(h), f}
+  defp ic(%Core.EIf{cond: c, then: t, else: e}), do: {:c_if, ic(c), iblock(t), iblock(e)}
+  defp ic(%Core.ECase{scrut: s, arms: arms}), do: {:c_case, ic(s), Enum.map(arms, &iarm/1)}
+
+  defp iblock(%Core.EBlock{stmts: stmts}), do: {:block, Enum.map(stmts, &istmt/1)}
+  defp iblock(e), do: {:block, [{:s_expr, ic(e)}]}
+
+  defp istmt({:bind, n, e}), do: {:s_bind, n, ic(e)}
+  defp istmt({:typed_bind, n, t, e}), do: {:s_typed_bind, n, t, ic(e)}
+  defp istmt({:expr, e}), do: {:s_expr, ic(e)}
+
+  defp iarm({p, g, b}), do: {:arm, ip(p), iguard(g), iblock(b)}
+  defp iguard(nil), do: :g_none
+  defp iguard(g), do: {:g_some, ic(g)}
+
+  # ── Core pattern -> the port's Pat sum ──
+  defp ip(%Core.PWild{}), do: :p_wild
+  defp ip(%Core.PVar{name: n}), do: {:p_var, n}
+  defp ip(%Core.PLit{value: v}) when is_integer(v), do: {:p_lit_int, v}
+  defp ip(%Core.PLit{value: v}) when is_binary(v), do: {:p_lit_str, v}
+  defp ip(%Core.PChar{value: v}), do: {:p_char, v}
+  defp ip(%Core.PAtom{name: a}), do: {:p_atom, a}
+  defp ip(%Core.PCtor{ctor: c, args: args}), do: {:p_ctor, c, Enum.map(args, &ip/1)}
+  defp ip(%Core.PTuple{elems: es}), do: {:p_tuple, Enum.map(es, &ip/1)}
+  defp ip(%Core.PList{elems: es, tail: :close}), do: {:p_list, Enum.map(es, &ip/1), :ptl_close}
+  defp ip(%Core.PList{elems: es, tail: t}), do: {:p_list, Enum.map(es, &ip/1), {:ptl_tail, ip(t)}}
+
+  # ── IR func -> the port's Func ──
+  defp ifunc(f) do
+    clauses =
+      Enum.map(f.clauses, fn c ->
+        pats = Enum.map(c.pats, fn p -> ip(Core.from_pat(p)) end)
+        guard = if c.guard, do: {:g_some, ic(Core.from_expr(Pratt.parse(c.guard)))}, else: :g_none
+        body = iblock(Core.from_expr(Pratt.parse_body(c.body)))
+        {:clause, pats, guard, body}
+      end)
+
+    {:func, f.name, Map.get(f, :pub?, false), length(hd(f.clauses).pats), clauses}
+  end
+
+  defp funcs_of(%{funcs: [], mods: [m]}), do: m.funcs
+  defp funcs_of(%{funcs: funcs}), do: funcs
+
+  defp ported(mod, src) do
+    prog = src |> Decl.parse() |> Rian.Opaque.erase()
+    funcs = prog |> funcs_of() |> Enum.reject(&(Map.get(&1, :dispatch) == :dispatcher))
+    mod.compile_prog(Enum.map(funcs, &ifunc/1))
+  end
+
+  @corpus [
+    "def add(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := a + b",
+    "def neg(a Int53) Int53 := -a",
+    "def cmp(a Int53, b Int53) Bool := a < b and a != b or not a > b",
+    "def quot(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := a div b rem a",
+    ~S|def shout(s String, n Int53) String := s <> "!"|,
+    "def maxi(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := if a > b do a else b end",
+    # multi-clause literal dispatch + recursion
+    "def fib(n Int53) Int53\ndef fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)",
+    # guard
+    "def sign(n Int53) Int53\ndef sign(0) := 0\ndef sign(n) when n > 0 := 1\ndef sign(_) := -1",
+    # sum variants: construction (tagged array) + ctor dispatch
+    "type Opt := None | Some(Int53)\npub def mk(n Int53) Opt\ndef mk(0) := None\ndef mk(n) := Some(n)",
+    "type Opt := None | Some(Int53)\ndef get(o Opt, d Int53) Int53\ndef get(None, d) := d\ndef get(Some(v), _) := v",
+    # tuple construction (Result) + tuple patterns in a case
+    "type E := Bad\ndef ok(x Int53) Int53 | E := {:ok, x}",
+    "def chk(x Int53) Int53 := case {:ok, x} do\n  {:ok, v} -> v\n  _ -> 0\nend",
+    # list construction + cons dispatch
+    "def hd(xs Vec(Int53), d Int53) Int53\ndef hd([], d) := d\ndef hd([h | t], _) := h",
+    "def cons(x Int53, xs Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53) := [x | xs]",
+    # atoms / case-expression
+    "def tag(b Bool) Symbol := if b do :yes else :no end",
+    "def classify(n Int53) Int53 := case n do\n  0 -> 10\n  m -> m + 1\nend"
+  ]
+
+  describe "self-hosting JS-module fixpoint — Rian emitter vs Rian.JS.compile" do
+    test "the Rian-emitted JS module equals Rian.JS.compile exactly", %{mod: mod} do
+      for src <- @corpus do
+        assert ported(mod, src) == JS.compile(src), "JS module diverged on:\n#{src}"
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "teeth — variants, dispatch, and JS operator/value encoding are real" do
+    test "a sum variant is a tagged array; a ctor pattern checks the head", %{mod: mod} do
+      assert ported(mod, "def mk(n Int53) Opt\ndef mk(0) := None\ndef mk(n) := Some(n)") =~
+               ~s(["Some", n])
+
+      out = ported(mod, "def get(o Opt) Int53\ndef get(Some(v)) := v")
+      assert out =~ ~s(a0[0] === "Some")
+      assert out =~ "a0[1]"
+    end
+
+    test "JS operator/value encoding (===, &&, atoms→strings, div→Math.trunc)", %{mod: mod} do
+      assert ported(mod, "def f(a Int53, b Int53) Bool := a == b") =~ "(a === b)"
+      assert ported(mod, "def f(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := a div b") =~ "Math.trunc(a / b)"
+      assert ported(mod, "def f() Sym := :ok") =~ ~s("ok")
+    end
+
+    test "discriminates structure", %{mod: mod} do
+      refute ported(mod, "def f(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := a + b") ==
+               ported(mod, "def f(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := a - b")
+    end
+  end
+end
